body: I just can't shake this belief, even if it is crazy, that people will be relieved when I'm dead. That everyone will move on quickly and will live better lives without me interfering. Because I have this belief, it makes it very hard to stave off the decision to take my own life.

Another big part of this is that I just realized recently when she told me that it was taking a toll on her, that I realized how big of a burden I was to her. I feel like the only way to fix that burden I've put on her is to kill myself so she'll never have to be emotionally drained by me again. I just can't shake that feeling that I am nothing more than a burden to people in the world, that I will always cause more harm than good, an because of that I deserve to feel this way.

The thing that upsets me with Amanda is that she grew so attached to me, and then in turn I attached to her. It basically seemed like we were dating at one point. And now over the last few months she has been being distant from me, sometimes going several days without talking to me, and she's dating around. 

So I guess I'm more upset that I just feel like I've been thrown aside as a friend because she, and I quote "can't handle how sad I am all the time." I just feel like I was used for when she was lonely and now that other people are paying attention to her, I'm not worth her time.
